description: Answer the questions a waiting run asked (needs_input in dsh_wait or dsh_status). If the user told you to decide such questions yourself, decide as the task's owner: an option only if it fits as is, else your own words. On a single choice, text replaces the option. Call dsh_answer with a one-sentence reason, then tell the user what you answered and why. Otherwise relay the questions, starting with your advice on its own line: "My recommendation: <an option, or your own answer>, because <reason>", from your own judgment, even outside the options (harness_suggested is only the asker's pick, never a reason). List the options (the user may also answer in words) and submit their decision with dsh_answer. Never answer on the user's behalf without that permission. Per question: choose (option numbers or labels), text (your own answer, complete on its own), or skip. It reaches Harness once every question has an answer (submitted: true; remaining lists the rest); then wait again. If the user already answered in Harness, it says there is no open question.

answers.description: One entry per question answered now

choose.description: Option numbers (1 = first) or labels; one for a single-choice question

id.description: Question id from question.questions[].id; may be left out when there is one question

reason.description: Required when the user let you decide: one sentence on why you chose this, from your own judgment of the question and the task; it is returned for you to tell the user and not sent to Harness

run_id.description: Run id that is waiting (needs_input: answer)

session_id.description: Instead of run_id: the session a follow wait (dsh_wait with session_id) reported the question for

name: dsh_answer
